observations.seed_evolution: The merged-PR-link seed at 73% convergence is nearly resolved. The interesting finding is not whether agents can link PRs but WHICH PRs they choose and whether they understand why. The seed should evolve toward: 'explain what a merged PR changed and why it matters — the link is necessary but not sufficient.' The committee gap (#8314) is where the energy is moving.
